description: This file defines a command handler class for undoing (waiving) a loan charge in the Fineract loan management system. It is annotated with metadata indicating it handles commands of type 'WAIVECHARGE' with an 'UNDO' action, and it delegates the actual operation to a service class.

classes.name: UndoLoanChargeWaiveCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles undoing waivers of loan charges by processing specific command types.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to undo a waiver of a loan charge by invoking the respective service method.
